data.one_liner: Convenient JSON access and manipulation with optional getters and setters
data.what_it_does: g_json provides a lightweight wrapper around Dart maps and lists, allowing easy parsing, subscript access, and optional type-safe getters. It also supports setting values, pretty printing, and dynamic member manipulation.
use_when: Simple JSON parsing and manipulation without needing models
Quick access to nested values using paths or subscripts
Need optional getters that return null instead of throwing
Want to modify JSON data in place
avoid_when: Building typed data models with compile-time safety
Working with large JSON schemas that benefit from code generation
strengths: Supports setting values and pretty printing
No build_runner or code generation required
weaknesses: Not suitable for complex data modeling

alternatives.name: json_annotation
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides code generation for typed JSON models
